newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen pare gains in late trade, eye FOMC.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen pare gains in late trade, eye FOMC.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures pared morning gains in late Monday trade on profit-taking but downside was limited by expectations of a steady Japanese monetary policy, dealers said.
A bout of short-covering following last week's selloff boosted March Euroyen futures to a high of 98.92 in the morning.
At 1115 GMT, March Euroyen was trading around 98.89 against its IMM close of 98.86 on Friday.
"Euroyen was reined in by Japan's May housing starts, which dropped 9.6 percent year-on-year. This is the fifth consecutive monthly decline," a dealer with a local institution said.
However, dealers said the dent on Euroyen was limited as the data was less severe than expected. The market was expecting a double-digit drop in Japan's May housing starts.
Sentiment was also cautious ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on Tuesday.
Dealers said the market had already priced in a steady U.S. interest rate policy.
September Japanese government bond (JGB) futures traded to a high of 124.38 before easing to close at 124.12, down 0.06 from its previous close. Volume was a paltry 326 lots.
Dealers said SIMEX JGBs reflected losses in its Japanese counterpart which saw about 30 billion yen worth of September JGBs sold below 124.20.
Eurodollars futures held steady in lacklustre trade ahead of the FOMC meeting.
March Eurodollar ended at 93.865 against its IMM close at 93.86 on Friday.
